confidence_notes: Food anchors draw on current Mykonos cost-of-living aggregates; cocktail and wine estimates reflect local bar ranges relative to draft beer and vary by venue. Accommodation is a holistic July high-season estimate, with substantial uncertainty from location and limited hostel supply.
comparable_city_reasoning: For accommodation, used high-season Cyclades island-resort pricing, with Santorini as a broad comparator. Food and drink estimates are Mykonos-specific.
